name: Remember That I Love You
summary: In Stormwind, a blood-stained letter is bound for Jeremy Heartweaver, now living with his adoptive mother, Avette Fellwood, in Duskwood.

sections.title: A Message for an Orphan
sections.body: War, hardship, and the kingdom's turmoil have left many children at the Stormwind Orphanage without families. Jeremy Heartweaver was among them until Avette Fellwood adopted him and brought him to live in Duskwood. There, gloomy woods bring peril and hard labor. The caretakers believed a family could offer him more than life in the city orphanage.

sections.title: A Grim Token
sections.body: The Blood-Stained Letter is meant for Jeremy Heartweaver, who is in Avette Fellwood's care. Its trail leads south past Elwynn Forest and into Duskwood. What tragedy followed Jeremy beyond Stormwind's gates, and why does the letter bear such a grim mark?

faq.answer: Jeremy Heartweaver is a young boy raised at the Stormwind Orphanage. Avette Fellwood recently adopted him, and he now lives and works in Duskwood.
Avette Fellwood is Jeremy's adoptive mother and lives in Duskwood. The matrons of Stormwind regard her as a sweet woman who likely took Jeremy in to gain another pair of hands for her daily labor.
The Blood-Stained Letter is meant for Jeremy Heartweaver and goes to his adoptive guardian, Avette Fellwood. It carries echoes of violence or tragedy.

faq.q: Where do I find Avette Fellwood?
faq.answer: Avette Fellwood lives in Duskwood, the dark forest directly south of Elwynn Forest, across the river.

faq.q: Why was Jeremy sent to Duskwood?
faq.answer: Jeremy was adopted from the Stormwind Orphanage. His caretakers believed a family and honest labor in dangerous Duskwood were better than life as an orphan in the orphanage.

faq.q: Which faction can take this quest?
faq.answer: Only the Alliance can take this assignment. It begins in Stormwind, the human capital, and leads into Alliance-held Duskwood.

angles.text: For the Alliance, tokens of fallen or vanished kin carried to adopted orphans speak to the personal costs of the kingdom's turbulent state.
As a human of Stormwind, you cross from the realm's relatively safe heart to Duskwood's haunted, forgotten settlements.

attribution: In-game quest text: Remember That I Love You
